description: Ethereum ERC-20 holder concentration from Blockscout: top 100 holders' share of total supply, top 10 share, and a Gini coefficient over those 100 balances. Gini is over the sampled top holders only, not all holders. For the very largest tokens (e.g. USDT) Blockscout can be too slow for the second page of holders; the answer then covers the top 50 (holdersSampled 50, top100SharePct null) and says so in note. Ethereum mainnet only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
